resources.string: Adds Input-only to a game’s menu on PCs whose host has no Input-only mode of its own. The PC still sends video and audio at the smallest size, under 1 Mbit/s; Nightjar doesn’t show or play them. Hosts with their own mode keep using it.
Video still streams at the smallest size, about %1$.1f Mbit/s (%2$d MB an hour), but isn’t shown
Allow input for this device on the host

Input only
Use touch, keys or a controller.
The PC still streams small video (about %1$.1f Mbit/s); it isn’t shown.
Back opens the stream menu.
Input-only on this PC uses a small ordinary stream, and the host refused it. Some hosts allow only one stream at a time: end the other stream or allow more in the host’s settings.
Another game is running on the PC. Input-only joins the running game and never quits it: choose that game, or end it first.
